items.title: Lillian Hardin Armstrong Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Then Joe asked me to join the band again and this girl went back. So, I joined the band. Then that made Louie and all of us the same band.

ctx.x: No, no. We went to this ballroom in San Francisco and stayed six months. Then, we went across to Oakland and played at the cabaret for about two or three weeks. I don't remember the cabaret, but it was in Oakland. Then, after that, after that job closed, they decided to go to Los Angeles. Well, I was afraid to keep staying out there because I slipped off to go there anyway. I told my mother we were going somewhere to make a record.
